newsitem.title: ROMANIA: NEW INDEX RELEASED FOR TROUBLED BUCHAREST BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NEW INDEX RELEASED FOR TROUBLED BUCHAREST BOURSE.

text.p: A second independent index has begun to rate Bucharest's stock exchange, confirming other indicators that show values were sliced by two-thirds in the first nine months of trading.

From a base of 1,000 points last November when Romania's first bourse in 50 years opened, the BIG Index, computed by Bucharest Investment Group SA (BIG) securities firm, fell to 351.61 points on Thursday, a BIG statement showed.
The BIG Index is a value-weighted index of the 13 traded stocks which BIG works out after each trading session on the basis of price moves and the capitalisation of listed firms.
It is the second unofficial index to appear. The stock exchange refuses to publish its own barometer for the bourse.

Another broker, Vanguard SA, devised its VAB value-weighted index in April. On Thursday, the VAB, which also had a 1,000 points base last November, rested at 353.3 points, 5.3 percent down from the previous session.
Stock exchange officials say an official index will only be worked out when companies more representative for the Romanian economy join in trading and the market is more stable.

The bourse attacked the VAB index when it came out saying it was unofficial and should not be used as a guide for investment. It said it would not assume responsibility for the effects the use of that index could have on making investment decisions. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
